market_summary: During the London session, markets across FX, precious metals, US equities, and crypto are experiencing low-volatility consolidation. All major assets are trading within their respective session Value Areas, tightly clustering around VWAP and key exponential moving averages (EMA20/EMA50) with sub-2.0 RVOL. Gold and silver remain range-bound near intraday POCs with bearish cumulative delta yet holding immediate support. EURUSD and GBPUSD display flat baseline compression around daily VWAPs. US100 and BTCUSD show corrective mean-reversions into descending VWAP overhead resistance without volume breakout confirmation. With no high-conviction momentum expansions or structural S/R breaks, capital preservation warrants a defensive HOLD posture across all six instruments pending New York liquidity.
